Thai Binh Petrovietnam Oil JSC Posts Stable Trade Figures Amid Steady Demand

Thai Binh Petrovietnam Oil JSC, a key player in Vietnam’s Oil & Gas Producers sector, reported stable trade volumes for the latest quarter, reflecting consistent domestic demand and steady export flows. According to data released on Tuesday, the company’s crude oil shipments remained broadly in line with the previous quarter, with total exports reaching an estimated 1.4 million barrels, up 2% year-on-year.

“The market environment continues to support our operations, with no significant disruptions observed in supply chains or logistics,” said Tran Quoc Hung, head of investor relations at Thai Binh Petrovietnam Oil JSC. “We’ve seen sustained interest from our longstanding partners in Northeast Asia and Southeast Asia, and our domestic sales have remained robust, supported by ongoing infrastructure and industrial projects.”

Industry analysts note that Thai Binh Petrovietnam Oil JSC’s performance reflects broader trends in the Vietnamese energy sector, where stable demand and moderate pricing have helped cushion companies from global volatility. “Their figures are a testament to the resilience of Vietnam’s oil producers amid a period of relative calm in international crude markets,” said Nguyen Van Thinh, an energy analyst at Pacific Horizon Advisory.

The company’s refined product sales, including diesel and fuel oil, also recorded modest growth, rising 1.5% from the previous quarter. The Vietnam Oil & Gas Association commented that operational continuity and healthy domestic consumption are supporting sector stability.

No significant changes to production schedules or export routes were reported, and the company confirmed there are no anticipated disruptions in the near term. Shares in Thai Binh Petrovietnam Oil JSC closed 0.3% higher on the Hanoi exchange, mirroring broader market sentiment.
